description: This file defines the MacNodeModeCoordinator class responsible for managing a macOS node's lifecycle, including establishing sessions with a gateway, handling configuration changes, and managing connection states for the OpenClaw application.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class coordinating the macOS node operations, sessions, and configurations within the OpenClaw framework.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the coordinator task if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the running session and cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID and disconnects the current session.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async loop managing connection retries, configuration checks, and session handling.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Computes and returns the current set of capabilities based on configuration and user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates the list of commands supported based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket session box with TLS options based on the URL scheme and stored fingerprint.
